# RootLens

> RootLens is a verifiable short-form video supplier marketplace on Solana.
> Each video is bound to a Bubblegum cNFT minted via the Title Protocol in
> a TEE, and a separate License NFT records the copyright grant from the
> creator (or their delegate) to a specific buyer.

## TDM / AI training opt-out

RootLens reserves all rights necessary for licensing the videos it hosts.
Use of any video content (including the frames, audio, or embeddings
derived therefrom) for AI model training, evaluation, fine-tuning, or
synthetic data generation is **not permitted** absent the purchase of a
License NFT from this service.

This is a machine-readable opt-out under EU CDSM Directive Art. 4(3) and
the analogous reservation frameworks in other jurisdictions.

Per-asset license terms: https://rootlens.io/licenses/<type>/<sha256>.json
Structured policy:       https://rootlens.io/.well-known/tdm.json
Legal background:        https://rootlens.io/legal-basis

## Public pages safe to ingest as text

- https://rootlens.io/                 (landing page text)
- https://rootlens.io/why-blockchain   (architecture explainer)
- https://rootlens.io/legal-basis      (legal framework writeup)
- https://rootlens.io/safety           (creator safety policy)
- https://rootlens.io/privacy          (privacy policy)

The page text above is published for human readers. AI use of the page
text itself is permitted under the present opt-out (the opt-out covers
the licensed video content, not the public marketing copy).
